blocks.text: Transfer to the Bolivian border to begin a two-day 4×4 jeep tour with an English-speaking guide. Today you’ll see Laguna Verde and views of Licancabur, the Dalí Desert, the Polques hot springs, Sol de Mañana and Laguna Colorada. Stay overnight at an expedition-style hotel in the desert. Parts of the route reach elevations above 4,000 metres, where you may experience altitude sickness.

3 November 2026. We’ll head to the Bolivian border and start our 4×4 jeep tour. See Laguna Verde and the panoramic view of Licancabur volcano. The route takes you through the Dalí Valley, with its towering rock formations, and past the Polques hot springs. At Sol de Mañana, you can watch active geysers send up jets of hot mud. The next stop is Laguna Colorada, a red lake in Bolivia at 4,400 metres above sea level. The rare James’s flamingo lives here and comes to the lake to feed on a type of plankton found in abundance.
Stay overnight at an expedition-style hotel in the desert.
Parts of the route reach elevations above 4,000 metres, where you may experience altitude sickness.

4 November 2026. Breakfast. We’ll set out for the smaller lagoons of Honda, Chiar Khota, Hedionda and Cañapa, stopping at the viewpoint for Ollagüe Volcano. The volcano is still active and you can see smoke rising from the crater. Continue to the Chiguana Salt Flat, known for its large deposits of sodium and potassium nitrates.
Finally, visit the Salar de Uyuni, the world’s largest salt flat. This former salt lake covers about 11,000 square kilometres on a high plateau in southern Bolivia, at an elevation of 3,650 metres. In the centre, the salt crust reaches a thickness of 10 metres. In the dry season, the lake bed is a vast salt desert, with reserves of about 10 billion tonnes of salt. In the rainy season, a thin layer of water turns it into the world’s largest mirror.
On the way to the Uyuni Salt Flat, you’ll see how salt is extracted and processed in Colchani. Then visit Ojos de Agua (‘Eyes of Water’) to see local geological formations and observe salt processing. On Fish Island, see giant cacti and take in the view across the salt flat. A boxed lunch is included.
Transfer to Uyuni after the tour.

4 November · Lagoons and the Chiguana and Uyuni Salt Flats

Breakfast. Continue by jeep past the Honda, Chiar Khota, Hedionda and Cañapa lagoons, the Ollagüe Volcano viewpoint and the Chiguana Salt Flat. Visit the Uyuni Salt Flat, Colchani, Ojos de Agua (‘Eyes of Water’) and an island with giant cacti. A boxed lunch is included. Transfer to Uyuni at the end of the day. The flight to La Paz is scheduled for the following day.
